findings.reason: gitNetwork() always sets GIT_SSH_COMMAND (fallback 'ssh'), overriding a user's GIT_SSH (plink/wrapper), and appends '-o BatchMode=yes' to any configured command a wrapper may not accept. Fix: leave GIT_SSH_COMMAND unset when GIT_SSH is set, or only add the flag when the resolved command is ssh.
lastFetchedAt() is not gated on config.git.enabled while statusAheadBehind()/fetch() are; with git disabled /api/git/status returns ahead/behind null but a real lastFetchedAt.
commit() emits git:status-changed only on 'committed'; when the commit lands but switchAfterCommit fails (status 'error'), refs moved but no event — sidebar badge stale until focus refetch.
Repo lock keyed by --show-toplevel (worktree root), not the repository; linked worktrees of one repo get separate locks. Key by absolute --git-common-dir to match 'one lock per repository'.
